title: Yes Bank Prosperity Business credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A Prosperity Business card designed for SMEs and entrepreneurs, offering cashback on utilities, travel, and business spends, with milestone vouchers and expense management features.

eligibility: Spend ₹50,000 or more in the previous quarter (Jan-Mar, Apr-Jun, Jul-Sep, Oct-Dec), you automatically qualify for this privilege in the subsequent quarter (Apr-Jun, Jul-Sep, Oct-Dec, Jan-Mar).
